data.title: 管理员 · 早餐前先等你坐下
data.description: 出门前在家吃早餐，女性管理员穿原作黑白黄机能服坐在小餐桌旁。她把烤面包盘推向你的座位，头微微转来，嘴角浮起浅笑；自己的咖啡仍没喝，像是特意等你一起开始。
data.action: 把吐司盘推向镜头的座位，转头等你
data.promptProse: The female Administrator sits at a small breakfast table in her original black technical jacket and pale high-neck sweater, angular blindfold mask in place. She slides the toast plate toward the viewer's seat and turns with a faint smile, her coffee still untouched. The eye-level medium view includes both place settings. Morning window light catches yellow jacket tapes and the plate rim, shading the table under her reaching wrist.
